caption: The drawing depicts a single straight razor with its blade open and positioned diagonally across the image. The blade is metallic, rendered in a light grayish-silver color with shading to suggest its reflective surface and sharpened edge. The handle is elongated, slightly curved, and colored dark brownish-black, with lighter streaks and a few small, circular metallic rivets securing the blade to the handle. The tang of the blade has the text "J. WESSON. 1841" clearly inscribed on it in a simple, black font. The background is plain and cream-colored, without any additional objects or patterns. The straight razor is centrally placed, and the illustration emphasizes the details of both the blade and the handle.
title: Barber's Sign
